item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 做了个小工具：让 iTerm2 tab 跟随 Claude Code / Codex 状态自动变色
item.description: Open-source tool ai-tab-color recolors iTerm2 tabs based on Claude Code/Codex status: blue for running, orange for waiting approval, green for done. It uses lifecycle hooks to write state and a poller every 5 seconds to change the tab color via iTerm2 OSC sequences, with config merging and auto-backup. Currently only macOS + iTerm2 are supported, and jq is required.

item.title: [infoq] DeepSeek 发布多模态模型，“小鲸鱼”长出了眼睛
item.description: DeepSeek launched an experimental multimodal model, deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, marking its first official API support for image understanding. Images are converted to tokens — up to 384 per image — and billed at the same rate as V4-Flash. Compared with V4-Flash-0731, most benchmarks improved (e.g., +5.6 on Toolathlon, +4.9 on DeepSWE), bringing text-agent performance close to Opus 4.8. API calls support Chat Completions, Messages, and Responses, with base64, URL, or Files API image input.

item.description: J-Space Cognition Suite claims to push DeepSeek V4-Pro-0813 past Fable 5 on agent benchmarks without modifying model weights, using only a runtime harness. Published results are self-reported with no independent reproduction yet. It targets 'representation drift' and 'premature stopping' by changing retry, memory, and stop conditions; despite the name, it's unrelated to Anthropic's J-space interpretability research.

item.title: [infoq] “Anthropic不再是AI圈的信仰”
item.description: Claude Code still leads AI coding tools on revenue, but momentum has shifted to OpenAI's Codex. Developers cite Codex's improved capabilities, higher rate limits, and more straightforward behavior, while complaining that Claude Code feels increasingly verbose and 'AI-sounding.' TickerTrends estimates Claude Code ARR at $15.12B vs Codex's $8.83B as of Aug 10, yet Codex's 20.8% monthly growth dwarfs Claude Code's 5.2%, closing the gap.

item.description: ECC is a performance-optimization system for agent harnesses, aimed at AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. item.title: [github_trending] virgiliojr94/book-to-skill
item.description: book-to-skill converts technical books, document folders, or source collections into a single reusable Agent Skill, ready to use inside Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, or Amp. It supports PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, HTML, RTF, and MOBI, and follows the open Agent Skills standard. If you want your technical library to become a queryable knowledge base for AI coding assistants, this tool is a practical starting point.
